card.name: Words introducing a purpose or reason
card.fires_on: Small linking words such as so, to, for, of or because right where a purpose or reason clause is about to begin (to enhance clarity, to minimize, so that streets are not congested).

modes.label: Purpose link
modes.description: The word 'to' or 'so' after a clause, introducing the aim of an action, often to avoid or improve something.
modes.example: Terminate the injection if lymphatic blockage is present<< to>> minimize introduction of Lipiodol into the

modes.label: Reason link
modes.description: A word such as 'because', 'of' or 'for' that introduces the reason behind a situation.
modes.example: Students who were schooled at home only because<< of>> a temporary illness were not included as homeschool

card.writes: It pushes the model toward words meaning prevent, avoid and protect, as in a clause stating a protective aim.
card.plain: It fires on little words that introduce why something was done, especially a goal like preventing or avoiding something.
